# The two waits of the desk have a deadline. With BUDGET_TIMEOUT the pause for a larger call cap ends as a failed run with a reason when nobody answers.
# With REVIEW_TIMEOUT the review of the draft ends the same way, and the finished sections stay in the store.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
env BUDGET_TIMEOUT=2s
env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=2

exec obeereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr 'REFUSE: no answer to the budget question within 2s'
! exists wiki.log


# The review wait, on a second item with a large cap. Its draft is ready, nobody answers, and the run fails with the reason.
env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=40
env REVIEW_TIMEOUT=2s
exec obeereal item add research-desk warm-cost --title 'Warm and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run warm-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr 'REFUSE: no answer to the review of the draft within 2s'
grep 'done' store/warm-cost/s1.1/status
grep 'done' store/warm-cost/s2.1/status
! exists wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
